reviewer: root; informed manual read of complete contract and all supplied examples
observations: The explicit subject noun/head has singular na or plural ne; its modifiers agree and the finite verb independently uses mo/mi or ko/ki. The intervening plural object case te does not change singular subject-controlled mo.
Changing subject identity at fixed number does not change agreement. This is a stipulated grammar consequence, not evidence for native r/l or a counted-object binding.

The negative modifier, negative factual predicate and prohibited command have distinct written scopes. A repeat/until block explicitly retains its object as the condition subject by repeating the full name and tests after the first action.
Quoted ordinary citations, name tokens, punctuation, brackets and every negative prefix remain visible control debt; none has a paid22-sign encoding.

Mandatory kind plus full name in every noun phrase is a restrictive and costly named-set teaching domain, not a necessity of ordinary language. Open pronouns, exact quantities, tense and other content are rejected rather than silently resolved.
decision: Do not select a large physical/statistical implementation from this contract alone. Retain the readable teaching contrasts and explicit restrictions; no general refutation of case/number agreement or real learned vocabulary.
not_done: No corpus encoding, source coverage or new native query
No measured writing speed, full physical script, statistical PASS or native meaning
selection_requirement: A motivated fixed content domain and complete paid physical writer preserving these contrasts; another abstract parsing demonstration alone does not change the selection decision.
